mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness, prompting anticipated central bank intervention and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in retail sales indicates synchronized labor market strength and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal (UNRATE decline + RSAFS rise) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term regression coefficient is positive with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) triggers anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as growth concerns dominate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand for housing, correlating with broader economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST rises, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 108.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as growth concerns intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 108.0, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in housing starts indicates supply shock in manufacturing coupled with strong consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal (INDPRO decline + HOUST rise) fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term regression coefficient is negative with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 2000.0 thousand units for two consecutive months signal robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 2000.0, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.
